offering_description.value: Cirrus designs and builds single-engine piston airplanes and light jets for private pilots, business aircraft owners and flight schools. It delivers aircraft through factory sales and international representatives and provides pilot training, maintenance and aircraft management.

primary_products.value: single-engine piston airplanes; single-engine very light jets; replacement aircraft parts

primary_services.value: pilot training; aircraft maintenance and repair; aircraft management

customer_segment.value: B2C: Private pilots and individual aircraft owners; B2B: Flight schools, flying clubs, businesses and charter operators; B2G: Military flight-training organizations

end_markets.value: personal aviation; civilian flight training; business aviation; air charter; military pilot training

revenue_model.value: product sales: New and pre-owned aircraft and replacement parts; service fees: Pilot training and aircraft maintenance; commissions or management fees: Aircraft management for jet owners; subscription: Premium connected-aircraft features
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; commissions or management fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds complete aircraft using sourced engines and avionics for individual owners and fleet buyers; service provider: Uses instructors and maintenance technicians to support pilots and aircraft owners

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Latin America and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Piston airplanes, very light jets, aircraft parts, pilot training and ownership services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Factory sales teams serving individuals and fleet buyers; own locations: Company-operated delivery, training and service centers; partners / resellers: International sales representatives and authorized training and service centers; online: Digital pilot courses and connected-aircraft subscriptions
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; partners / resellers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Aircraft design and production require FAA certification and applicable approvals from foreign civil aviation authorities.
